I will simply do my best in the duty assigned to me, as I always have.
Manager... are you doing your best at this moment?
You should rewind the clock now, Manager.
If you are too exhausted to rewind the clock, I recommend that you cease command, withdraw, and rest.
The enemy has been staggered.
A Sinner is down. They may require protection.
The enemy has been eliminated.
A Sinner has been killed. It's an unwelcome loss.
I agree that this is painful and arduous. Even so, in this fierce battle... I find enjoyment.
Every decision you have made in this battle has proven sound. Accordingly, I look forward to your next judgment, Manager.
There is insufficient basis for a judgment, but subjectively speaking... I believe this battle is worth continuing, Manager.
There is little time remaining. If you find it difficult to make a judgment call, you may leave it to me.

2 vibrations from the floor to the left. 31 gazes sweep across our vulnerable points.
Manager, a concentrated assault is imminent.
Even if this situation lies beyond both our experience and memory, we should be able to understand it by concentrating on the present.
You identified the vulnerable point correctly.
Being inefficient does not mean that it is wrong. To call something "inefficient" is, in itself, a practice in subjectivity.
That was efficient.
If that was your preferred method, then there should be no issue.
The world has never once escaped irrationality. The present will be no different.
They must be mad.
The rationale behind this assistance is... difficult to understand.
The pain we must bear has increased.
An enemy part has been destroyed.
The suppression of the enemy is proceeding smoothly. Now that you have broken a part, formulate the next plan based on your assessment of its properties, Manager.
Regrettably, Manager, several Sinners have been injured.
In light of this experience, I believe our overall strategy requires revision... What do you think, Manager?
Critical damage inflicted.
... The enemy still retains the will to fight.
A Sinner has eliminated multiple enemies.
You did well, Manager.
The boulder has merely rolled down again. It is too early to conclude that we have failed. Will you climb again, Manager?
Sinner #5, Meursault. Beginning recording. No specific order was issued, but I always wished to try when my turn came.
